verdict.rationale: x402 provides documented rails (HTTP 402 handshake, CDP Facilitator settlement, exact/upto/batch schemes) for settling agent payments in USDC and other ERC-20/SPL stablecoins across Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum and World, with agentic wallets explicitly designed to let AI agents pay mid-task, and real third-party operators confirm production use. Missing for 10: independent large-scale audits of settlement reliability beyond vendor-reported volume figures and self-reported community usage.
